name: In Case of Emergency
source:
In Case of Emergency is a fantasy romance visual novel with role-playing elements. Play as Kieran, an almost-college grad who enrolls in summer remedial classes after failing his final semester of school.  When he stumbles upon a mysterious staircase on campus, he discovers a dying world of swords, magic, and prophecy.

[From [url=https://phibbean.itch.io/in-case-of-emergency]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《In Case of Emergency》是一部带有角色扮演元素的奇幻恋爱视觉小说。你将扮演基兰，一名即将大学毕业的学生；他最后一个学期没能通过课程，于是报名参加暑期补修班。当他在校园里偶然发现一段神秘楼梯后，便踏入了一个正在消亡的世界，那里有剑、魔法与预言。

[来源：[url=https://phibbean.itch.io/in-case-of-emergency]Itch.io[/url]]
